threshold_reason: Arc public mainnet launched today with more than 100 applications and more than 100 institutional/ecosystem builders, creating a genuinely new venue rather than a recycled narrative catalyst.

Within roughly two hours, monitoring cited about $372M of USDC resident on Arc and about 176,000 on-chain addresses. Reports also documented users paying 80%-100% USDC premiums before launch to reach Arc early for meme-token trading, strong evidence of discretionary speculative urgency rather than ordinary yield farming.

ARC Screener data reported about $127M of 24h trading volume across the top 500 Arc tokens, about $57.91M of on-chain liquidity, roughly 767,000 transactions and roughly 30,200 listed tokens. This is actual secondary trading/velocity, not simply stablecoin issuance or RWA AUM.

Early leadership is concentrated in new high-volatility assets: ARGUS represented about $21.97M of reported volume and TOLLY about $9.12M. The first-day breadth and velocity are sufficiently abnormal to qualify Arc as a new speculative-capital destination, but not sufficient to qualify any token for a paper buy.

capital_migration_classification.stablecoin_capital_stock: ~$372M USDC reported on Arc within roughly two hours of launch; this is capital/settlement stock, not turnover.
capital_migration_classification.secondary_trading_velocity: ~$127M reported 24h trading volume across the top 500 tokens against ~$57.91M of on-chain liquidity; volume/liquidity >2x signals high capital velocity but also high slippage/reflexivity risk.
capital_migration_classification.wallet_breadth: ~176K addresses reported shortly after launch, but raw address counts receive low weight because sybil/bot/new-launch churn is unmeasured.
capital_migration_classification.new_token_activity: ~30.2K listed tokens and ~767K transactions reported; scored as regime breadth only, not as evidence of profitability or organic user quality.
capital_migration_classification.why_capital_appears_discretionary: Users reportedly paid 80%-100% premiums on USDC to reach Arc early for meme trading, which is difficult to explain as rational yield-farming economics. This is an unusually strong revealed-preference signal for speculative access.
capital_migration_classification.incentive_contamination: Token-specific reward mechanics remain material. Tolly routes a portion of buy fees to holder rewards and TOLLY/project-token buy-and-remove mechanics; ArgusPad permits creator-configurable holder rewards and buyback/burn allocations. Those flows are discounted rather than treated as purely organic demand.

rwa_classification.availability_or_issuance: Circle says USYC and BlackRock BUIDL are available on Arc and can be traded, lent, or posted as collateral, alongside other RWA issuers/builders.
rwa_classification.actual_secondary_or_collateral_usage: NOT_YET_VERIFIED at meaningful scale in this run. Day-one availability and AUM are not counted as secondary trading, collateral utilization, or sustained institutional settlement.
rwa_classification.interpretation: The current qualified Arc regime is speculative/new-token capital migration. Institutional RWA infrastructure is a separate future confirmation leg, not part of today's opportunity score.

catalysts: Gate announced deposits and forthcoming spot listing
ArgusPad documentation/reporting describes platform-fee value capture with a portion used for ARGUS market buybacks/burns
preliminary_leadership.wallet_quality: UNQUALIFIED: one reported early trader turned about $1.2K into a large mostly unrealized position and still held ~10.1M ARGUS; historical selectivity, funding independence and cohort convergence are not established.
gate_reasons: Arcscan identifies ARGUS as a 45-byte proxy forwarding to an implementation contract.

Arcscan reports the deployed source as unverified and holder-query data unavailable, preventing verification of dangerous permissions, implementation upgrade authority, holder concentration and linked-wallet distribution.
Arcscan itself could not compute a reliable on-chain price because it considered liquidity too thin; third-party market-cap/circulating-supply data conflict materially.
Creator-configurable fee allocations and holder rewards contaminate some activity and create governance/implementation dependencies that require contract-specific audit.
preliminary_leadership.paper_action: REJECT_FOR_NOW; opportunity score cannot override unresolved structural gates.

gate_reasons: Tolly states that launched project-token supply enters permanently locked USDC liquidity, which is positive for those project LP-removal risks, but this does not by itself prove the TOLLY platform token's ownership/permission/concentration safety.
Tolly explicitly routes part of buy fees to holder rewards and platform/project-token buy-and-remove mechanics, so its demand/turnover is incentive-contaminated under the framework.
No independent selective-wallet cohort, beneficial-owner distribution audit, creator-dump audit or complete permission review was verified in this run.
preliminary_leadership.paper_action: REJECT_FOR_NOW pending persistence and full structural verification.

official_arc_token_warning.evidence: Circle says it completed the genesis mint of 10B ARC tokens as a technical milestone but explicitly says this is not a commitment to publicly launch ARC. Network fees remain payable in USDC.
official_arc_token_warning.implication: Do not treat any currently traded token using the ARC ticker as the official Circle Arc network token without direct Circle confirmation.

ecosystem_catalysts: Founding validators include BlackRock, DTCC, ICE, Mastercard, Visa and other financial institutions
Day-one Aave, Morpho and Uniswap integrations
Uniswap, Aero and fomo named by Circle as day-one trading infrastructure
Major exchanges and wallets provide immediate distribution/access
major_uncertainties: The ~$372M USDC and ~176K-address figures come from very early post-launch monitoring and need persistence/reconciliation against canonical chain analytics.
Top-500-token volume can be dominated by bots, wash trading, launch snipers and recycling of the same USDC; independent wallet-quality/funding-lineage analysis is not yet adequate.
Reported token counts and transactions are raw activity measures and not evidence of unique profitable users.
First-day price gains of hundreds or thousands of percent create extreme adverse-selection and liquidity risk.
RWA products are available on Arc, but meaningful secondary volume, borrow/lend utilization and collateral velocity have not yet been established.

paper_portfolio.source_of_truth: paper_portfolio/state.json and paper_portfolio/trades.jsonl read before decision
paper_portfolio.reason: Arc qualifies as an ecosystem-level speculative regime, but no Arc-native token currently passes the framework's structural, wallet-quality and persistence gates. Existing portfolio positions do not require an action from the Arc event alone.

existing_position_watch.UNI: HOLD_NO_ADD. Arc is an independent distribution catalyst for Uniswap, but the reported Arc speculative volume is not yet attributable enough to Uniswap protocol revenue/UNI burn to justify moving the existing ~5% position toward the 7.5% cap.
existing_position_watch.ZEC: HOLD_NO_ADD. Price has retraced sharply from the $1,204.97 confirmation-add mark, but shielded capital stock remains ~28.9% and positive 24h shielded net flow persists. A few hours of price reversal alone does not yet meet the portfolio sell discipline's requirement for persistent negative price/holder/liquidity confirmation.
existing_position_watch.HYPE: HOLD_NO_ADD. Prior institutional-distribution conflict remains unresolved; no Arc-specific action.
existing_position_watch.AERO: HOLD_NO_ADD. Do not assume Circle's day-one 'Aero' integration automatically creates AERO-token value capture without verified token-level linkage.
existing_position_watch.SUI: HOLD_NO_ADD. Weak DEX momentum and the previously announced Phantom support sunset remain headwinds, but no new hard structural failure occurred in this run.

why_signal_matters_now: Arc has moved from an institutional/RWA launch narrative into observable first-day speculative capital migration: substantial USDC stock arrived, traders paid extreme access premiums, and new-token turnover is already large relative to available liquidity. The framework should now track Arc as a live speculative ecosystem while refusing to chase first-day leaders until contract safety, holder independence, wash/bot quality and persistence are verified.
